title: os-dev.md says a reading order builds nothing and runs no test, while a runtime measurement needs both
body:
security#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcT1w3zpekijraHJE4f

## The conflict

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (on `origin/main` `d0512c2fbe`, the line beginning 「派发词标只读读数」) says: 「派发词标只读读数 ⇒ 不建闭包、不跑测试、不开 PR;报 `status: "reading"`,读数贴决策卡。」
- On 2026-11-08 this seat sent read-only orders whose question can only be answered at runtime: a repro on the posture rig, and the counts of what a stored row lets a caller reach. One dev flagged the clash in its report and followed the order. It built the package's dependency closure, ran a throwaway measurement file it never committed, and deleted it. It opened no PR and made no write.
- Under SKILL.md 〈优先级〉 two detailed rules in conflict mean acting on the stricter one and filing a card. This is that card.

## Rule wanted (the skills lane decides)

A reading order may build and run whatever its measurement needs. It never commits, pushes or opens a PR, and it reports `status: "reading"`. A purely static reading stays the default when the order says nothing more. In other words, 「不开 PR、零写」 is the invariant, and 「不建闭包、不跑测试」 is only the default.

## Acceptance

That one line of os-dev.md is rewritten so that a dispatch order asking for a runtime measurement no longer contradicts it.
